title: Receive before restlessness starts running
subtitle: For the heart that mistakes motion for faithfulness
description: The same Hukam lines meet a different wound: the need to move because receiving feels exposed. These readings slow the escape, then let saint company and Shabad turn stillness into faithful presence rather than paralysis.

heroSource.shortMeaning: All things already stand in Hukam, so restless motion is not always obedience; sometimes it is refusal to receive.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Before adding a task, stay with the given circumstance for one breath and ask what obedience looks like here.

evidence.coreClaim: This path treats restlessness as flight from the humility of receiving Hukam.
evidence.turn: Stillness becomes faithful when the heart stops using motion to outrun what has been given.
evidence.practicalImplication: Pause before movement, receive the present condition aloud, then act only on the next truthful duty.
